name: Coral bleaching
summary: No fifth global bleaching event declared by NOAA as of 26 Nov; the very strong El Niño raises the risk of one
state: NOAA says the fourth global coral bleaching event likely ended in 2025 and has not declared a fifth (NOAA NESDIS). Scientists have asked whether the strong El Niño will bring a fifth global event (CORDAP). Searches on 26 Nov found no new NOAA global declaration, so Normal holds, with risk rising as El Niño persists into the southern summer.
for_you: No direct action for readers; reef tourism areas may see bleaching in the coming months.
rubric_hit: No global bleaching event in progress = Normal

sources.title: NOAA NESDIS — World's fourth mass coral bleaching event likely ended in 2025
CORDAP — Will the El Niño bring a fifth global coral bleaching event?

why: Reefs support a quarter of marine species and coastal economies; mass bleaching is a direct sign of ocean heat stress.
drivers: Marine heatwaves, El Niño, warming trend.

rubric.alert: Bleaching extent at record levels with active new alerts in the past month.
rubric.watch: Global bleaching event in progress, or regional mass bleaching.
rubric.normal: No global bleaching event in progress.
